name: Tool Issue
query:
Select 
TI.name AS "Document No:Link/TMS Tool Receipt",
TI.posting_date AS "Date:Date:100",
TI.customer AS "Customer:Link/Customer",
TI.customer_name AS "Customer Name",
TI.branch AS "Branch",
TI.cpc_component AS "CPC Component",
TI.machine AS "Machine",
TI.operation AS "Operation",
TI.pfep AS "PFEP:Link/PFEP Tooling Plan",
TII.item_code AS "Item:Link/Item",
TII.item_name AS "Item Name",
TII.physical_tool_code AS "Physical Tool Code",
TII.qty AS "Qty",
TII.valuation_rate AS "Rate",
TII.issue_value AS "Amount"

From `tabTMS Tool Issue` TI
inner join `tabTMS Tool Issue Item` TII on TII.parent = TI.name
Where TI.posting_date between %(from_date)s and %(to_date)s
